newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian peso ends up on dlr at 1,083.40.
newsitem.headline: Colombian peso ends up on dlr at 1,083.40.

text.p: Colombia's peso ended 1.75 pesos higher against the dollar at 1,083.40 on dollar-selling by banks, interbank dealers said.
They said the peso traded mostly sideways in a range of 1,084 to 1,085 until midday, when banks with over-extended foreign exchange positions began selling U.S. currency.
The selling lifted the peso to an intraday high of 1,083.15 but it gave up 0.25 centavos before the close.
Dealers reported 331 trades for a total of $165 million and said they expected to see the peso trend slightly higher for the remainder of the week.
